_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "sex" TEXT NOT NULL, "birth_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "height_cm" REAL NOT NULL, "start_weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "target_weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "target_date" TEXT NULL, "body_fat_percent" REAL NULL, "occupation" TEXT NULL, "job_activity" TEXT NOT NULL, "sport_minutes_per_week" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sport_note" TEXT NULL, "sleep_hours" REAL NULL, "diet_style" TEXT NULL, "eating_habits" TEXT NULL, "allergies_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "preferred_foods_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "disliked_foods_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "calorie_override" INTEGER NULL, "protein_override_g" INTEGER NULL, "protein_per_kg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.8, "fat_percent" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 30.0, "fiber_target_g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 30.0, "water_override_ml" INTEGER NULL, "activity_credit_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_slots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "minute_of_day" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "food_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'g', "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs" REAL NOT NULL, "sugar" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "fat" REAL NOT NULL, "saturated_fat" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "fiber" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "salt" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "serving_amount" REAL NULL, "serving_label" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diary_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "day_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_slot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "food_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "kcal100" REAL NOT NULL, "protein100" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs100" REAL NOT NULL, "sugar100" REAL NOT NULL, "fat100" REAL NOT NULL, "saturated_fat100" REAL NOT NULL, "fiber100" REAL NOT NULL, "salt100" REAL NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weight_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "day_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "body_fat_percent" REAL NULL, "waist_cm" REAL NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "water_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "day_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "ml" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "day_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "steps" INTEGER NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "external_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "servings" REAL NOT NULL, "cooked_weight_g" REAL NULL, "prep_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "instructions" TEXT NULL, "tags_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "food_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kcal100" REAL NOT NULL, "protein100" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs100" REAL NOT NULL, "sugar100" REAL NOT NULL, "fat100" REAL NOT NULL, "saturated_fat100" REAL NOT NULL, "fiber100" REAL NOT NULL, "salt100" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "from_recipes" TEXT NULL, "checked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("checked" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "form" TEXT NULL, "serving_label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Portion', "manufacturer_dose" TEXT NULL, "servings_per_day" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "times_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "stock_servings" REAL NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplement_ingredients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "supplement_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nutrient_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplement_intakes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "supplement_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "servings" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX foods_key ON foods (food_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX foods_barcode ON foods (barcode)
CREATE INDEX diary_day ON diary_entries (day_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX weight_day ON weight_entries (day_key)
CREATE INDEX water_day ON water_entries (day_key)
CREATE INDEX activity_day ON activity_entries (day_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX activity_ext ON activity_entries (source, external_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX recipes_key ON recipes (name_key)
CREATE INDEX recipe_items_recipe ON recipe_items (recipe_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX supplements_key ON supplements (name_key)
CREATE INDEX supplement_ingredients_sup ON supplement_ingredients (supplement_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX supplement_intake_slot ON supplement_intakes (supplement_id, day_key, planned_minute)
CREATE INDEX supplement_intake_day ON supplement_intakes (day_key)
